events.title: US-Iran War: Strait of Hormuz Blockade Active Since February 2026
events.description: Active war between US/Israel and Iran since February 2026. Iran has blockaded the Strait of Hormuz since Feb 28, 2026. IRGC boarding/attacking merchant ships, sea mines deployed. US blockaded Iranian ships Apr 13 - May 29. Trump reinstating blockade as of Aug 12. Negotiations ongoing but stalled. Brent crude at $93.26/bbl. Oil surged 5%+ on Aug 11 when Hormuz talks stalled.

events.title: Coordinated US-Japan Yen Intervention — First Since 2011
events.description: US Treasury and Japan executed first coordinated yen intervention in 15 years on July 31, 2026. US sold euros to buy yen via NY Fed on Treasury's behalf. Japan deployed ~$36.58B. FIMA facility used to avoid selling US Treasuries. 5-standard deviation move in USD/JPY. Bessent called BOJ 'behind the curve' on inflation. BOJ held rate at 1.00% post-intervention. Yen rallied to 155 then unwound to ~159. Structurally distinct from 2011 — executed amid sovereign debt stress.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic — WHO PHEIC Declared, Fastest-Growing Outbreak on Record
events.description: Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. WHO declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. As of early August: 4,053 confirmed cases, 1,850 deaths. Second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in history, largest ever in DRC. WHO warns it could surpass the 11,000-death 2014-2016 outbreak. Existing treatments certified for Zaire species, not Bundibugyo — complicating response. Cases confirmed in Goma (major transit hub).

events.title: Gold at Record Highs Above $4,400 — Safe Haven Panic Driving Markets
events.description: Gold futures at $4,460.90 (+2.27%), holding near record territory above $4,400/oz. Driven by Iran war safe-haven demand, Hormuz uncertainty, and yen intervention fallout. Oil surged 5%+ on Aug 11 when Hormuz talks stalled. Brent at $93.26. Markets pricing in possible Fed rate hike (~30% probability). UK rate hike expectations shifted from cuts to possible hikes due to Middle East conflict inflation transmission.

us_fed.notes: Fed expected to hold at 3.50-3.75% for 5th consecutive meeting. ~30% probability of rate hike priced in. New Fed chair emphasizing inflation. No emergency action detected.

latam.notes: Argentina country risk at 451bps, decoupling from regional rally. Brazil-Argentina diplomatic tensions escalating. Argentina central bank reform vote Aug 19. US Treasury ESF $2.5B lifeline to Argentina noted. No category-5 event.

eu_ecb.notes: ECB raised rates in June 2026 (hike). Rates unchanged since. Bulgaria joined Eurozone Jan 2026. No emergency action detected.

uk.notes: CPI inflation at 2.6% (above 2% target). Middle East conflict shifted expectations from 2 rate cuts to possible rate hikes. No BOE emergency action but gilt market stress building. Routine gilt issuance continuing.

japan.notes: Coordinated US-Japan yen intervention July 31. First since 2011. BOJ at 1.00%, Bessent calling BOJ 'behind the curve'. FIMA facility expansion requested. 5-sigma move in USD/JPY.

china.notes: PBOC nudging yuan fix stronger. USD/CNY at 6.7442, yuan up 6.08% over 12 months. No emergency policy detected.

em_asia.notes: EM Asia defending currencies. India rupee recovering from May record low via diaspora dollar deposits. South Korea won biggest monthly gain since 2022. Won leading declines on Aug 10. No crisis-level event.

middle_east.notes: Active US-Israel-Iran war since February 2026. Hormuz blockade active. Trump reinstating blockade Aug 12. Negotiations stalled. Oil elevated. Houthi attack on Saudi Aramco Jazan refinery Aug 9.

africa.notes: Ebola outbreak in DRC/Uganda — WHO PHEIC declared. South Africa central bank warns of 'silent crisis'. Nigeria alleged coup plot against Tinubu. No new category-5 political event, but health crisis is category-5.

financial_system.notes: No active bank failures or credit freeze detected. Regulatory cuts raising systemic stability concerns per American Banker. ECB June 2026 rate hike pressuring banks. Reserve requirement ratio cut expected in China to increase lending capacity.

commodities.notes: Brent at $93.26, gold at $4,460.90 (record territory). Oil surged 5% on Aug 11 Hormuz talks stall. Iran demanding concessions (end blockade, compensation, sanctions relief, unfreeze assets) before reopening Hormuz. Food prices elevated but IMF index declining.

pandemic_health.notes: 2026 Ebola epidemic — Bundibugyo ebolavirus. WHO PHEIC declared May 17. 4,053 cases, 1,850 deaths. Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever. Could surpass 2014-2016 outbreak (11,000 deaths). No treatments certified for Bundibugyo species.
